note:
There's a question of whether AI in the future will look like and whether it'll be completely alien to us. This idea is that AI is a kind of unknowable entity that only pantomimes human interaction. The meme is of an eldritch terror, a shoggoth, that has a mask that it holds up to talk to humans.

While this might be the case, I wonder if human cognition is a kind of 'steady state' and that more and more intelligent beings are just the same base level pattern, just sped up. The idea being that, from the outside, it looks superhuman because of the speed of solution whereas local to the entity's frame, the entity has had orders of magnitude more time to work out solutions. A kind of "speedster" model.

I suspect AIs are more akin to speedsters than to shoggoths.

A mentor of mine talked about if aliens came to earth and their intelligence was so completely foreign to us, we would still be able to communicate from a common reference frame by talking about minimal solutions to solving a Rubick's cube. A solution to a Rubick's cube can be verified and is a concrete measure. It doesn't need deep understanding of an intellect to understand the solution presented and it doesn't need a deep model of personality to understand to communicate trying to find the minimal number of moves for a solution.

Reality imposes it's own constraints with it's own measures of success and ways of verifying solutions. We'll see, but, at least anecdotally, the current batch of LLMs seem much more like speedsters than they do shoggoths to me.
